title: Lime gift card in hand, black trip-history screen and a smartwatch on a wooden ledge with foliage

Use big round filter chips in the app.
Show a watch UI in natural light.
Repeat the arc graphic across surfaces.

A branded card with a promise of value.
A circular chip for filtering lists.
